note: Goldens for v37_mmr_permanence_test — the MMR permanence-peaks SHADOW (src/c2pool/v37/mmr_permanence.hpp). The shadow reads the REAL canon v37::Lane read-only and computes an append-only MMR of the leaves of evicted buckets; the gate is OFF by default (activation_pos=UINT64_MAX) and DECOUPLED from LaneParams::shipped()/SHIPPED_CONSENSUS_VERSION. It appends NOTHING into the canon lane digest. Wiring the peak-root into the live consensus digest (the inline V37P leaf + owed_digest fold + a gate-ON consensus golden) is the out-of-scope position-gated activation.

hard_acceptance_gate.note: GATE-OFF byte-identity: with the shadow compiled in but the gate at its UINT64_MAX default, shadow_digest()==lane.digest() at every step and the canon per-step digest fingerprint is unchanged. Driving the real canon v37::Lane over the KAT-0 scripts (ratified + small geometry) reproduces the frozen fingerprint. If it moves, the shadow is not inert -> NO-SHIP.

hash_discipline.bag: right fold, tallest peak outermost; single peak = itself; empty range = all-zero
hash_discipline.v37b_leaf_payload: V37B || level(u64) || pos_lo(u64) || pos_hi(u64) || raw_work(u128) || epoch_tag(u64) || comp_hash(32), byte-equal to the lane's live bucket leaf
